axes_front_minus_y.note: profile anatomy.front: toes/tips ahead of the ankles (-Y), listed parts and the weapon ahead of the body

corner_normals_agree_with_winding.note: area share of polygons whose mean custom corner normal points against the polygon normal

corner_normals_preserved.expected: min dot > 0.999 against the captured import normals (base: inverse-transpose of its scale)

export_frame_indicators_rotated.note: centroids relative to the body centroid in the re-imported FBX before undoing the 90.0 deg rotation

feet_on_base_top.expected: lowest foot vertex within [-0.003, 0.003] m of the base top (profile anatomy.feet_sink_m)

height_m.note: figure height = top of scale.top_part (tripo_part_2) above the base bottom; a weapon or wing may reach higher

orientation_inside_out_parts_as_profile.note: ray-escape score < -0.5 on the Tripo geometry

roundtrip_scale_ratio_1.note: Blender re-reads the cm FBX (UnitScaleFactor 1.0) as metres

triangulate_changes_no_geometry.note: preset use_triangles=True: the export writes triangles only; meshes that were already all triangles keep their count, quads/ngons become exactly their loop triangles

uv0_inside_own_atlas_cell.note: every UV corner of an atlas mesh lies in its part's inner cell rect (gutter kept)

uv0_raster_overlap_measured.note: informational: texels covered by >= 2 triangles / covered texels, per part at atlas resolution

weapon_bone_on_weapon.note: bone tail at the highest weapon vertex, head on the fitted weapon axis inside the hand part's bounds

weapon_grip_bridge_closes_gap.expected: an open 10-sided cylinder on the fitted shaft axis from source z 0.585 to 0.664
weapon_grip_bridge_closes_gap.note: Tripo modelled no shaft inside the fist; the weapon was two shaft islands with a gap hidden by the fist

weights_heat_fallback_measured.note: vertices the heat solve left unweighted, given 1.0 on the nearest allowed bone (informational)

weights_only_group_bones.note: per part: bones outside the group's list (must be empty)

weld_inside_parts_measured.note: bmesh remove_doubles at 1e-06 m inside each part; islands_after per part

cross_part_coincident_vertices.note: parts are not welded to each other; listed only to show where seams can open under deformation

expected_ue_bounds_uu_at_import_scale_1.note: *_blender_axes: authored frame (front -Y), centimetres; *_export_frame: as written into the FBX (re-imported); *_ue_predicted: export frame mapped as UE (x, -y, z) per ART-001

deviations_from_preset.bake_anim: off: the candidate FBX carries no clips
deviations_from_preset.path_mode: STRIP instead of AUTO: bare texture names; textures reach UE from the atlas stage, not through the FBX

figure.note: figure height = top of scale.top_part; the skeletal mesh top (UE bounds) is the highest vertex of body and weapon

not_checked: art acceptance, silhouette, lighting, K1/K2/K3 (art track)
deformation quality in animation; clips are not built by this stage (rig_deform_probe runs separately)
budgets: numbers are measured only (proposals until GD-058)
UV intra-part island padding (Tripo's own layout inside each cell)
selection collision (UCP_ capsule proposal; skeletal meshes use a physics asset in UE)
UE-side facing and socket world positions: ue-import stage (bounds axis map) and live frames

footprint_vs_base.note: informational: how far the figure reaches past the base rim

proposed_limits_comparison.note: comparison with proposals only, not budgets (GD-058 open)

sockets.location_source: predicted from the Blender bone-local target (UE bone space = (x, -y, z)); verify with a live get_socket_location against target_ue_component_uu
